subject: Acme trial — ownership, success criteria & short timeline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@acme.health>, Devon Blake <devon.blake@acme.health>
Cc: procurement@acme.health, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Acme trial — ownership, success criteria & short timeline

Hi Linda / Devon,

Great conversation earlier — thanks for walking us through the use case. Per our discovery call I wanted to capture the agreed trial scope and proposed owners so we can keep momentum: 

High-level success criteria (what Acme wants to validate)
- End-to-end inference latency under 120ms p95 on your API calls for 512 token prompts
- Consistent semantic retrieval quality (embedding-based recall > 85% on seeded eval set)
- Stable infra under a synthetic concurrent load of 40 RPS for 60min

Proposed trial deliverables & timeline
- Prep & infra readiness (VPC peering + firewall rules) — target 1 week (owners: Acme network + Redwood infra)
- Baseline eval run & seeded prompts — 1 business day once infra is up (owners: Acme product + Redwood solutions)
- 7-day soak test and quality review — outcomes & decision meeting after soak

Ownership (initial proposal)
- Infra (VPC, peering, security groups): Acme network team (Devon) + Redwood infra (Marcus)
- App integration (API calls, test harness): Acme product (Linda) + Redwood solutions (Grace)
- Security/compliance review (data flows, audit logs): Acme security + Redwood security/compliance (Aditya)
- Procurement / PO / SOW: Acme procurement (procurement@acme.health) + Redwood sales (me)

Next steps (I propose):
1) Marcus to confirm Redwood infra tasks and estimated time for peering and test endpoint setup
2) Devon to confirm when network can schedule the peering and any corporate firewall constraints
3) Grace to share a minimal test harness (curl + sample prompts) and the seeded eval set
4) Procurement to indicate PO timing / any required contract redlines

Attached: acme_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (draft success criteria & eval checklist), network_requirements_ddos.pdf (network checklist template)

If this looks right I’ll schedule the kickoff for next Tuesday — please flag any changes to owners or timeline.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0122
From: Devon Blake <devon.blake@acme.health>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Linda Park <linda.park@acme.health>
Cc: procurement@acme.health, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme trial — ownership, success criteria & short timeline

Stephanie — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Network windows: We can schedule the VPC peering next Wednesday (4/27) morning PST. Our security team requires the peering checklist (firewall ports, IP ranges) at least 48 hours before the scheduled change.
- Audit logs: Our compliance team will want to validate the presence of request/response audit logs and retention settings (30 days standard, SOC2 evidence requested).
- Procurement: We need a one-page SOW and estimated monthly run-rate (ballpark) to start internal approvals. I’ve CC’d procurement — they prefer to receive the SOW + PO template by Friday (4/22).

On owners: I confirm Acme network will lead peering, but we’ll need Redwood to open the endpoint and provide the test hostname and IPs. For security review please point Aditya to our security questionnaire (I can share it).

Thanks — Devon

--
Devon Blake
Network Engineering Manager | Acme Health
devon.blake@acme.health
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-20T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Acme trial — ownership, success criteria & short timeline

Marcus / Grace / Aditya — forwarding Devon's note. Can you confirm Redwood's commitments and put a short list of action items (owner + ETA) so I can send the one-page SOW + timeline to procurement?

Suggested internal split to confirm: 
- Redwood infra: provision test endpoint, shared IPs, brief runbook for peering (owner: Marcus)
- Solutions eng: deliver test harness and seeded eval set, help run baseline (owner: Grace)
- Security/compliance: complete Acme security questionnaire, provide SOC2 snapshot & audit-log config (owner: Aditya)

If you can reply with owners + ETA by EOD Thursday (4/22) I’ll assemble the SOW and schedule the kickoff.

Thanks,
Stephanie
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Linda Park <linda.park@acme.health>, Devon Blake <devon.blake@acme.health>, procurement@acme.health
Date: 2027-04-22T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme trial — ownership, success criteria & short timeline

Thanks — quick RACI and delivery commitments below so Stephanie can finish the SOW. I’m keeping items actionable and minimal for the trial window.

RACI (trial phase):
- Provision test endpoint & IPs: Responsible — Redwood infra (Marcus Lin). Accountable — Stephanie (to confirm schedule). Consulted — Acme network (Devon). Informed — procurement. ETA: 48 hours after signed SOW / access to firewall details.
- VPC peering guidance (runbook + ports): Responsible — Redwood infra (Marcus). Deliverable: one-page peering runbook. ETA: 24 hours.
- Test harness + seeded eval set: Responsible — Redwood solutions (Grace O'Connor). Accountable — Grace. Deliverable: repo + curl examples + seed prompts. ETA: 2 business days after endpoint is up.
- Baseline eval execution & report: Responsible — Redwood solutions (Grace) + Acme product (Linda). Deliverable: CSV with metrics + short slide with pass/fail vs success criteria. ETA: 3 days after harness run.
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 snapshot: Responsible — Redwood security (Aditya Rao). Deliverable: completed questionnaire + SOC2 report excerpt + audit-log config doc. ETA: 2 business days.
- Procurement / SOW & pricing: Responsible — Redwood sales (Stephanie). Accountable — Stephanie. Deliverable: one-page SOW, estimated trial run-rate, DocuSign link. ETA: EOD 4/22 (I recommend sending now so Acme procurement can start).

Operational notes / blockers:
- We will need Acme to provide the specific firewall egress/ingress IP ranges and schedule a peering window.
- For latency metrics we’ll instrument p95 reporting; Grace will include the exact curl commands.

Next steps I’ll take now:
1) Draft test endpoint and generate IPs once SOW is signed.
2) Send the peering runbook PDF to Devon and Acme network.
3) Grace will upload the harness to the shared Drive link (I’ll notify when done).

Stephanie — if that aligns I’ll hand these deliverables to engineering and mark dates on our calendar.

— Marcus Lin
Director, Infra & Production | Redwood Inference
